---
title: "F-NMCOM — Non-malleable commitment"
status: "Canonical"
layer: 4
---

*F-NMCOM* (Non-malleable commitment) is part of *Layer 4: Commitments and Proofs* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

There is no ideal functionality distinct from *F-COM*/*F-MCOM* for this primitive: Canetti and Fischlin show that UC-realizing the (multi-session) commitment functionality already implies non-malleability, so *F-COM*/*F-MCOM* is itself the ideal functionality this primitive UC-realizes, strictly subsuming the earlier game-based non-malleability notions below.

*References:*

- Canetti and Fischlin. [*Universally composable commitments*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2001/055). In Advances in Cryptology – CRYPTO 2001, volume 2139 of LNCS, pages 19–40, 2001.
- Crescenzo, Ishai, and Ostrovsky. [*Non-interactive and non-malleable commitment*](https://web.cs.ucla.edu/~rafail/PUBLIC/37.pdf). In 30th ACM Symposium on Theory of Computing (STOC), pages 141–150, 1998.
- Fischlin and Fischlin. [*Efficient non-malleable commitment schemes*](https://iacr.org/archive/crypto2000/18800414/18800414.pdf). In Advances in Cryptology – CRYPTO 2000, volume 1880 of LNCS, pages 413–428, 2000.
